name: Warlords: Call to Arms
author: Addicting Games
description: Warlords: Call to Arms is a free tower defense. Wage a war of territorial control in this real time strategy game. Pick your faction, select your units, and then commence your campaign of territorial domination. Each mission you complete successfully will give you gold that you can use to upgrade your units or buy additional ones. From there, it’s just a matter of gradually capturing different parts of the map until you have it all. Heed the call to arms and be the Warlord you were destined to be.
